reviewer: Independent native Codex subagent; no external candidate source/model output accessed
authorization_scope: Only source-grounded native function parameter and one-level literal-key scalar bindings. No answer encoding, reward transformation, scorer source rewriting, helper/operation/library model or obligation-predicate expansion.
implementation_simplification: Owner deleted unused duplicate preparation helper after independent review; final diff leaves one validation/preparation path and no behavior expansion.
limits: Actual caller/source evidence establishing native scalar domains and canonical True/False references is collection responsibility; metadata flags alone do not prove runtime inputs.
Binding model assumes native mappings with declared literal keys and native scalar values; aliases of whole mappings are intentionally unmodeled.
Default and nonnominated parameters remain unmodeled if evaluated.
Scalar reassignment is interpreted by the existing Term environment, not rebound to original values; mapping reassignment is rejected conservatively.
Unknown helpers, effects, variadics, hidden self state, unsupported operators and returns remain Unknown.
This review establishes bounded binding behavior on synthetic regressions, not independent task detection or LLM benefits.
